 Police called to motor vehicle crash outside Stillwater Self Storage 
 Posted on Wednesday, November 18th, 2026 at 9:05 pm     
 STILLWATER, OK – Stillwater police were dispatched to the scene of a serious motor vehicle crash that took place outside Stillwater Self Storage on Wednesday.  
 According to Koco5 , the crash happened at the intersection of West 6th Avenue and Redlands Road.  
 Stillwater fire crews also responded to the scene and told drivers to proceed with caution as workers cleaned up debris from the crash and removed the impacted vehicles.  
 No injuries have been reported at this time, and the cause of the collision is under investigation.  
 This information is presented as a way to help keep our community safer and is not meant to be taken as legal advice. However, the Oklahoma car accident attorneys at the Abel Law Firm have helped clients secure financial compensation for their medical bills, lost wages, and other expenses. If you or someone you love has been injured in an accident involving another vehicle, contact us today for a free consultation.
